For people with some martial arts experience

Join a regular class.

Already trained in jiu-jitsu, MMA, kickboxing, Muay Thai or wrestling? You’re welcome to join us. Bring your experience and we’ll help you connect it to the rest of MMA.

Expect live training games, positional rounds and technical sparring with specific goals. Tell the coach where you’re coming from and train with care for the person in front of you.

€10 per drop-in, paid on arrival. Contact the club before your first visit to check the session is suitable and ask what to bring.

The people behind the room

Your corner.

Volunteer coached. Independently minded. Invested in the people on the mats.

Founder & head coach

Vinny Connolly

An outside-the-box thinker who built his own way of developing complete MMA skills. Vinny created the Bronze, Silver and Gold Wolves system: no belts, just a standard earned across the whole sport.

The Wolves system

Co-head coach & club lead

Marcus Fields

Marcus combines hands-on coaching with running the club: organising training, making the day-to-day decisions and keeping the room moving. A coach committed to the progress of the people training in it.

Semi-retired coach

John Burke

Practical, crafty and full of useful details that stay with you. John brings an old-school edge, a punk-rock spirit and a wicked, unfiltered sense of humour. Semi-retired, but very much part of the club’s character.

Get to know the club

What makes a Wolf?

How we trainTrust, live games & getting better

Our way of training

High standards.
No big egos.

Wolves in sheep’s clothing. A nonprofit club with serious ability, where getting better matters more than looking tough. Compete if you want to. You don’t have to.

Learn by doing. Look after each other.

No pad-work routines or push-up circuits. We build skills through live training games, positional sparring and technical rounds with a specific task to solve. You learn timing, decisions and what works against a partner who is responding.

That only works with trust. Challenge each other, control the intensity and help your training partners improve. Skills, confidence, enjoyment—and a reason to keep coming back.

NonprofitThe room comes first.
Volunteer coachedPeople teach because they love the sport.
Pressure testedKeep what works against real resistance.
One sport. Three ranges.Striking, wrestling & ground work

One system · three ranges

Change the range.
Keep the intent.

Distance is never neutral

Strike with the takedown in mind.

Footwork, hands and kicks taught in the reality of MMA—where the level change, clinch and cage are always part of the exchange.

The Wolves systemBronze, Silver & Gold

No paid grading days

The Wolf
standard.

Created by founder Vinny Connolly, the Bronze, Silver and Gold Wolves system recognises progress across the complete sport—not belts or time served. The coaching team agrees when a level has been earned. There are no paid grading days, and no pressure to compete.

B
Bronze Wolf

Fundamentals that hold up.

A dependable base across striking, wrestling and grappling, with the ranges beginning to connect.

S
Silver Wolf

Amateur-ready MMA.

Technical depth, composure and a complete MMA skill set suited to the amateur circuit.

G
Gold Wolf

Professional standard.

A complete, tested game capable of operating at professional level.
